name: word-roller-blur
title: Word Roller Blur
description: A line of small caps over a big word: each word blurs in sharp from soft and fades while blurring away before the next one, and the last word stays crisp.
useWhen: A headline word that changes through a few qualities (creative, powerful, elegant) with a soft, calm hand-off.
A light, premium tone on a pale background.
avoidWhen: The swap should feel mechanical or kinetic: use a drum or flap roller.
A single phrase that only blurs in once: use focus-blur-resolve or soft-blur-in.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Lead-in
variables.description: Small caps line above the word.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. A wide word shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
